summary: All 51 LRE requirements are implemented and traced in java.generated.project/result_codegen.json. Eleven decisions the requirements do not settle are listed below: 2 invented defaults, 5 design choices, 3 ambiguous requirements and 1 scope question. None is unimplemented.

issues.title: 'No obstacle' index is a non-negative sentinel, not -1
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6/DM5/OP3/OP4 say cstc/cdyn = -1 means no obstacle, but the same requirements type them as natural numbers and the Java profile maps int to nat (never negative).
issues.fix_directive: Kept: closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() return ObstacleRegister.NO_INDEX (2147483647, written as a plain literal), an index put() refuses to register. The controller never tests it: every sensor function returns its no-obstacle default (large distance, zero field) for an empty index.

issues.title: 'Safe large distance' is 1000000.0 m
issues.raw: LRE-DM5: when no obstacle exists, odist, hdist and vdist return a safe large distance (value not given).
issues.fix_directive: Kept as a private sensor constant SAFE_LARGE_DIST = 1000000.0, far above every threshold (all 1 m).

issues.title: Actuator holds 0.0 velocity and heading before any advice
issues.raw: LRE-DM8: the actuator stores the latest advVel/advHdng values; no initial value is given.
issues.fix_directive: Kept: advisedVelocity and advisedHeading start at 0.0.

issues.title: CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA take the closest index from the sensor themselves
issues.raw: LRE-OP2: CheckOPEZ uses the index computed by CalcCStc. LRE-OP5: CalcCPA uses cdyn. The profile allows an operation's compute() to use only sensor calls and its own fields.
issues.fix_directive: Kept: CheckOPEZ.opezIndex and CalcCPA.cpaIndex are assigned from sensor.closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex(), the same call CalcCStc/CalcCDyn make on the same sensor snapshot in the same step, so the values are equal to cstc/cdyn.

issues.title: CPA formula: horizontal CPA plus constant vertical separation
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 gives no formula for cda/tcpa. LRE-DM5 says nsRelDist/ewRelDist return 0 with no obstacle, which would make a position-only CPA report cda = 0 (a false collision) whenever the AUV moves and no dynamic obstacle exists.
issues.fix_directive: Kept: closing velocity c = AUV velocity - obstacle velocity; tcpa = (p.c)/|c|^2; cda = sqrt(|p - c*tcpa|^2 + vdist^2). vdist's large default makes cda large when no dynamic obstacle exists. obs_roc is not used (the sensor has no accessor for it). When |c| = 0, tcpa and cda are NaN: no collision is predicted, and CAM's exit guard !(cda < minSafeDist) holds.

issues.title: HCM velocity: 0.1 m/s (system description) vs 0 m/s (LRE-FR3)
issues.raw: system_description.txt: 'HCM: Reduced speed (0.1 m/s)'. LRE-FR3: 'On entering HCM, the LRE advises a velocity of 0 m/s'.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented LRE-FR3 (HCM_ADVISED_VEL = 0.0); the requirements are the source of truth.

issues.title: Literal '1' thresholds in LRE-Beh4/Beh9/Beh11
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4: vel <= 1, odist(cdyn) > 1, odist(cstc) > 1. LRE-Beh9/Beh11: hvel/vvel at or above 1 m/s. None names minSafeDist.
issues.fix_directive: Kept as the requirements state them, as named constants VEL_LIMIT = 1.0 and MOM_ENTRY_CLEARANCE = 1.0 independent of MIN_SAFE_DIST.

issues.title: Transition priority within each mode
issues.raw: All LRE-Beh requirements have priority 8; their relative order within a mode is not given.
issues.fix_directive: Kept: in MOM and HCM the autonomous (triggerless) transitions come first: inOpez (so LRE-Beh5/Beh16's guard is inOpez alone), then collision -> CAM, then the static-obstacle rules (MOM: Beh9, Beh11, Beh10; HCM: Beh13). The operator's requests (reqOCM, endTask, reqHCM) follow, each conjoining the negation of every autonomous guard, because RoboChart has no event-absence guard. In CAM, Beh18 precedes Beh17. Beh11 precedes Beh10 because with equal thresholds Beh10's guard contains Beh11's, so the other order would make Beh11 unreachable. Consequence: an operator request arriving in the same cycle as an autonomous transition is not acted on in that cycle.

issues.title: vvel is the signed rate of climb
issues.raw: LRE-OP1: 'vvel is the rate of climb'. LRE-Beh11: vvel at or above 1 m/s.
issues.fix_directive: Kept literally: vvel = rateOfClimb (signed), so Beh11 fires on climbing at >= 1 m/s, not on descending. Beh10 covers vertical proximity regardless of velocity.

issues.title: Inputs with no transition are ignored; CAM issues no evasive command
issues.raw: LRE-Beh19: in modes other than OCM, operator velocity/heading inputs are overridden. LRE-FR4: CAM performs evasive manoeuvres (no output given). LRE-DM7: advVel/advHdng are the only outputs.
issues.fix_directive: Kept: reqVel/reqHdng are ignored outside OCM; reqOCM, reqHCM and endTask are ignored in OCM; reqMOM, reqHCM and endTask are ignored in HCM and CAM. CAM has no entry action because no evasive command is specified. A cycle with no operator input is step(null).

issues.title: Ties between equally close obstacles go to the lowest index
issues.raw: LRE-OP3/OP4: return the index of the obstacle with the minimum odist.

next_step: Run the pipeline. None of these items blocks it; revisit them only if a verifier or the requirement owner objects.
